title: BrickForge validation fixture library
generation: LEGO-scale construction fixtures use centimetre coordinates; advanced geometry fixtures retain millimetre coordinates. Basic beam meshes are deterministic 0.8 mm voxel-boundary surfaces.

fixtures.title: Solid block
fixtures.description: A solid 6 × 2 × 2-stud beam blank, dimensioned in centimetres and aligned to brick-course geometry.

fixtures.title: Single through-hole
fixtures.description: A 6 × 2 × 2-stud beam with one 4.8 mm Technic-style through-bore, centred in a stud cell and passing across the 16 mm width.

fixtures.title: Three-hole pattern
fixtures.description: A 6 × 2 × 2-stud beam with three 4.8 mm through-bores at two-stud intervals, aligned to the stud grid.

fixtures.title: Blind pocket
fixtures.description: A cylindrical pocket opens on one face but stops inside the solid.

fixtures.title: Oblique bore
fixtures.description: A diagonal cylindrical bore crosses the block at an angle.

fixtures.title: Curved tunnel
fixtures.description: A smoothly bending tunnel passes through the block. It is deliberately more difficult than a straight cylindrical opening.

fixtures.title: Branching tunnel
fixtures.description: Two intersecting bores form a T-shaped internal passage.

fixtures.title: Simple car silhouette
fixtures.description: A deliberately blocky car-like shape with integrated wheel volumes. It is a geometry challenge rather than a detailed vehicle model.

fixtures.title: Thin-wall panel
fixtures.description: A long, narrow 2 mm-thick wall with reinforcing returns. Challenges thin-feature preservation and grid resolution.

fixtures.title: Arched bridge
fixtures.description: A solid bridge-like form with a semicircular arch passing through its depth.

fixtures.title: Cantilever overhang
fixtures.description: A stepped base supports an upper beam that projects beyond the base, leaving a clear underside.

fixtures.title: Hollow sphere
fixtures.description: A closed spherical shell with an internal void, useful for distinguishing an enclosed cavity from an open tunnel.

fixtures.title: Intersecting solids
fixtures.description: Two rectangular volumes overlap and are fused into one solid, testing compound geometry and overlap handling.

fixtures.title: Organic lobed form
fixtures.description: A fused multi-lobed solid with rounded contours, a step beyond simple block geometry.

fixtures.title: Two-hole Technic beam
fixtures.description: A 6 × 2 × 2-stud beam with two 4.8 mm through-bores at two-stud spacing, aligned to the stud grid.

limitations: These are voxel-derived benchmark meshes, not CAD-grade analytic surfaces. Their 1 mm surface quantisation is intentional and should be considered when comparing fine dimensions.
Expected feature counts describe design intent. Current sampled algorithms may report candidates rather than exact topology; tests should record both expected intent and observed result.
The car fixture is a simple silhouette, not a mechanically detailed or physically functional vehicle.
The LEGO-scale beam fixtures are 6 × 2 × 2 stud envelopes with 4.8 mm bores; their grid-clearance representation is deliberately conservative and may enlarge the physical opening to whole stud cells.
